opportunities.title: 3 MCP servers run an unpinned package
opportunities.detail: playwright, postgres, notes (Claude Desktop) fetch whatever version is newest each launch, so a bad or hijacked release runs with your tools' access the moment it ships. Pin at least the major version.

opportunities.title: 2 MCP servers are handed credentials
opportunities.detail: postgres, figma receive environment variables, usually API keys, stored in plain text in your Claude config. Know which servers hold which keys, and scope those keys as narrowly as the vendor allows.

opportunities.title: 1 remote MCP server
opportunities.detail: github runs on someone else's machine: what you send there leaves this computer. Worth checking the trust rating before pointing it at client work.

opportunities.title: 1 agent inherits the session model
opportunities.detail: An agent with no model runs on whatever you are using, often the most expensive one. Naming a lighter model for search and summarising agents cuts spend with no quality loss.

checks.detail: Informational: a pinned default keeps sessions predictable.

checks.title: Prices agree with the vendor
checks.detail: This app's rate card matches what the vendor recorded for the same tokens.

checks.title: 80% of spend is on the largest models
checks.detail: $1063 of $1329 in 30 days went to the top tier. Searching files, reading logs and summarising do as well a tier down; giving those jobs to subagents on a lighter model is the usual way to cut this without touching the hard work.

checks.title: One session has been open 18 days
checks.detail: It cost $87 in the last 30 days. A session re-sends its growing history on every turn, so an old one pays more for each answer and gets slower to steer. Starting fresh for new work, and keeping what matters in project memory, is cheaper.

checks.title: Spend is attributable
checks.detail: Less than a quarter of spend is without a work area.

checks.title: Custom agents are in use
checks.detail: Specialist agents keep long jobs out of the main context.

checks.title: No subscriptions recorded
checks.detail: The app cannot say what the tools cost, when they renew, or whether each plan earns its price until the Subscriptions tab has your numbers.

checks.title: Work areas are not mapped to clients
checks.detail: 4 work areas exist. Mapping them turns spend into a per-client figure you can bill or justify.
